title: A neuroprosthesis restores words for a man with paralysis
summary: Neural networks decoded the attempted speech of a man with stroke-related paralysis, displaying words and sentences on a screen. With a 50-word vocabulary, the system reached up to 18 words per minute and a median accuracy of 75%. Proof of principle in one person, using an implant on the brain surface and a limited vocabulary.
ai_technology: Neural networks for speech and language model

evidence.tested: Decoding was tested in one participant over 48 sessions using a 50-word vocabulary, reaching up to 18 words per minute and a median accuracy of 75%.
evidence.unknown: It is a proof of principle in one person with a limited vocabulary, per the press release.
evidence.ai_role: Deep-learning algorithms decoded attempted words from cortical activity.
